BiblicalUsage: Thine is the word of belonging, and Jesus uses it of everything. All mine are thine, and thine are mine, He prays, and He asks the Father to sanctify them through thy truth, while the father in the parable tells his son, all that I have is thine.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe thine is the happiest word in the prayer: what is Christ's is the Father's, and what is the Father's is ours in Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
